hotels.title: Vietnam All-Inclusive Oasis: Family-Friendly Bliss with Waterpark & Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Discover coastal luxury redefined at Alma Resort Cam Ranh, a breathtaking tropical sanctuary stretching across 30 pristine hectares of Vietnam's stunning Cam Ranh Peninsula. This fully-integrated resort in one of Southeast Asia's most celebrated seaside destinations has mastered the art of the perfect family escape - where every desire is anticipated and every moment is crafted to delight. Fourteen distinctive restaurants and bars take you on a culinary journey around the world, from authentic Vietnamese flavours and casual bites at the Beach Bar, to Italian classics at La Casa and refined seafood dishes with ocean views at Atlantis. Beyond the table, 12 spectacular pools cascade gracefully toward the golden sands of Long Beach, while a thrilling waterpark keeps the whole family entertained from morning to night. Here, the hardest decision of the day is simply choosing where to begin. When it's time to slow down, the resort's world-class amenities invite you to savour every second. Surrender to sublime treatments at Le Spa, catch a film at the resort's very own cinema or challenge the family to a round on the 18-hole mini golf course. From sunrise yoga on the beach to moonlit strolls along the shoreline, Alma Resort Cam Ranh creates those pinch-me moments where luxury feels personal and paradise feels like home.

hotels.title: All-Inclusive Vietnam Beachfront Pool Villas with Massages & Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Escape to this all-inclusive pool villa paradise on one of Vietnam's most spectacular stretches of shoreline. Set on undisturbed Long Beach in Cam Ranh Bay - just fifteen minutes from the airport - this luxury haven delivers everything you need to fully unwind, all backed by Meliá's legendary hospitality. Savour views over the resort’s magnificent lake while dining at Merkado, or enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine at Muối. Return to your lavish villa, where a spacious outdoor terrace and private pool make lazy afternoons feel effortless. For a slower reset, retreat to YHI Spa, ease into a yoga session or book time on the tennis courts, all while younger travellers burn energy at The Kidsdom between swims in the beachfront pool.

hotels.title: Five-Star Vietnam Beachfront Escape with Three Restaurants, Water Park, Outdoor Pools & Spa
hotels.description: Nestled amid lush tropical gardens on a white sandy beach, discover the magic of Vietnam's captivating and picturesque Cam Ranh Bay. With each room offering direct ocean views, this five-star retreat offers a serene sanctuary, with its private beach, shimmering infinity pool, water park and spa. Delight in the flavours of the world at Chübeli Beer House or indulge in the local seafood at Panorama Restaurant. When it's time to explore, the vibrant city of Nha Trang awaits, offering bustling markets and stunning landscapes. Explore the nearby coastal town, famous for its mud baths and cultural sites. When you return, bask in mesmerising sunsets before another day of adventure within the resort.

hotels.title: Five-Star Vietnam Beachfront Escape with Three Restaurants, Three Outdoor Pools & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Discover the magic of Vietnam's captivating and picturesque Cam Ranh Bay with a stay at this elegant beachfront retreat. Savour authentic Vietnamese cuisine at Lang Viet Restaurant & Bar or master the art of Vietnamese cuisine by joining a traditional cooking class. Unwind by one of three outdoor pools and rejuvenate at The Anam Spa, a tranquil sanctuary. When it's time to explore, the vibrant city of Nha Trang awaits, offering bustling markets and stunning landscapes. With serene beaches on your doorstep, embark on unforgettable island-hopping adventures. Explore the nearby coastal town of Nha Trang, famous for its mud baths and cultural sites. When you retreat to this elegant haven, unwind at Saigon Bar with handcrafted cocktails and melodies from the resident pianist.
